item.title: About Me
item.description: Overview Hi 👋 I’m Bibby and I write code. I write highly scalable web applications and services. I usually code in Go these days; sometimes in Java, JavaScript, Ruby, Python, or C. I usually store my data in Postgres and Redis; sometimes I use Dynamo, Mongo or MySQL. I build software platforms on AWS (sometimes Azure or Google Cloud) managed with Terraform and Ansible, and my infrastructure is always code.
